title: Wanda Ya Fara Neman Gafara
intro: Komawa baya zuwa lokacin da ya gabaci fitowar rana ta farko, kafin wani mutum ya yi tafiya a duniya. An ƙera wani mutum daga mafi ƙasƙanci kayan aiki, an ba shi matsayi sama da mala'iku, aka kuma sanya shi a cikin lambu mai tsarki tare da gargaɗi bayyananne. Duk da haka a cikin ɗan lokaci guda, an yi zaɓi - wanda zai yi ta maimaitawa a duk tarihin ɗan adam. Wanene wannan mutum?
clues: An kawo ni cikin rayuwa ta hanyar da ba ta saba da kowace ba — an ƙera ni daga ƙurar ƙasa kuma aka ba ni rai mai rai ta hannun Mahalicci.
An ba ni ilimi mai zurfi har ma mala'iku a sama sun yi mamakinsa.
An umurci dukkan sammai su yi mini sujada, kuma duk suka miƙa wuya - sai ɗaya, wanda ya ƙi saboda girman kai.
An sanya ni a cikin wani lambu mai tsarki, wuri mai jin daɗi da wadata har abada - amma tare da haramcin guda ɗaya.
Na manta, na zame, kuma na yi rashin biyayya - kuma na ji nauyin kuskurena sosai.
Na koma ga Ubangijina da kalmomi masu ratsa zuciya, kuma Ya karɓi tubata, domin Shi ne Mafi gafara.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: An umurci mala'iku da su yi sujada
An aika da Babban Ruwan Tsufana
An yi wata babbar wuta mai sanyi kuma lafiyayye
An nutsar da wani mai girman kai a cikin teku
trial.answer: An umurci mala'iku da su yi sujada

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An nutsar da shi cikin teku
Wani babban kifi ya haɗiye shi
An yi wa al'ummar ƙasar mummunan bugu
Iska mai zafi ta ƙone ta

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
